basic_details.offering_entity: Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB), Republic of Turkey
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: State and Foundation Universities across Turkey (Middle East Technical University - METU, Boğaziçi, Istanbul Technical University - ITU, Bilkent, Koç, Istanbul University, Sabancı, Ankara University)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to almost all disciplines: Engineering, Computer Science, Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Social Sciences, International Relations, Islamic Studies, Economics, Architecture, Agriculture.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~4,000 to 5,000 scholarship awards distributed globally each year
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: ~100 to 150 scholars from Pakistan selected across undergraduate and postgraduate levels annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Bachelor's: 4-6 years + 1 yr Turkish prep; Master's: 2 years + 1 yr Turkish prep; PhD: 4 years + 1 yr Turkish prep

nationality_requirements: Citizens of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan (must not hold Turkish citizenship)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Undergraduate: Under 21 years; Master's: Under 30 years; PhD: Under 35 years of age on January 1 of application year.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed HSSC / A-Levels for Undergraduate; 16-year Bachelor's for Master's; 18-year MS/MPhil for PhD from recognized institutions.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum academic achievement: 70% for Undergrad; 75% for Master's/PhD; 90% strictly for Health Sciences (Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Academic background aligned with the intended faculty in Turkey.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final year (must graduate before August of application year).
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: For Turkish-taught programs: No language score required at application; YTB provides 1 year of free Turkish language preparatory training (TÖMER). For English-taught programs: TOEFL iBT and GRE/GMAT scores required as stipulated by individual top universities (METU, Boğaziçi, Bilkent).
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Mandatory 1-year Turkish Language Course (TÖMER) provided to ALL scholars, even those in English-taught programs.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Students currently enrolled in Turkish universities are ineligible for the same study level.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Previous Türkiye Bursları recipients cannot re-apply for the same level.

tuition_fee.details: 100% exemption from all university tuition fees for the full program duration.

admission_application_fee.details: No university application fees via the Türkiye Bursları portal.

accommodation.details: Free accommodation in state student dormitories (KYK dorms); scholars who opt for private housing receive a monthly rental stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living allowance paid directly to the student's Turkish bank account.
monthly_stipend.amount: TRY 3,500/mo (Undergrad), TRY 5,000/mo (Master's), TRY 6,500/mo (PhD) (regularly indexed to inflation) (~PKR 35,000 to 65,000/mo)

airfare.details: One-time round-trip flight ticket provided: one inbound flight to Turkey upon commencement, and one outbound flight upon graduation.

visa_fee.details: Turkish Student Visa issued with fee waiver upon presentation of YTB scholarship acceptance documents.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive General Health Insurance (Genel Sağlık Sigortası - GSS) under the Turkish Social Security Institution (SGK).

food_allowance.details: Free breakfast and dinner included in KYK state student dormitories.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Covered via monthly stipend or campus library facilities.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: YTB Research Support Grants available for doctoral dissertation fieldwork.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free 1-year Turkish language preparatory education course (TÖMER) fully covered.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Applicants select up to TWELVE university and department preferences across at least two different Turkish cities.
participating_institutions: METU Ankara, Boğaziçi University, Istanbul Technical University, Bilkent, Koç, Istanbul University, Sabancı, Ankara University, Ege University, Hacettepe
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 1 to 20 universities in Turkey; QS World Top 400-800.
available_majors: All disciplines (Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, International Relations, Islamic Finance, Architecture, Law)
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Bachelor's: 4-6 years; Master's: 2 years; PhD: 4 years (+ 1 yr Turkish language)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Online TBBS application, transcripts, personal statement, study proposal, extracurricular certificates.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Single integrated application: Applying via the TBBS portal simultaneously secures both university admission and full scholarship placement.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Do not select only Istanbul and Ankara universities; including strong provincial universities (e.g. Ege University Izmir, Bursa Uludağ) ensures higher placement probability.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the TBBS online portal using valid email address and Pakistani passport/CNIC during the single annual application window (January 10 - February 20).
step_by_step_workflow: 2. Fill profile: Personal Info, Education Info, Language Info, Work Experience, Social Activities.
3. Select up to 12 university and program preferences.
4. Write Statement of Purpose and Research Proposal (for Master's/PhD).
5. Upload academic transcripts, certificates, passport, and extracurricular awards.
6. Submit online application before February 20 deadline.
7. Preliminary expert review of dossiers (March - April).
8. Shortlisted candidates invited for in-person panel interview in Islamabad, Lahore, or Karachi (May - June).
9. Final selection results announced on TBBS portal (late July - early August).
10. Sign Scholarship Agreement, obtain Turkish Student Visa, receive free flight ticket (August).
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated 1-step routing: YTB places selected scholars directly into their approved university programs.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded directly by candidate on the TBBS portal (scanned letters on university/company letterhead).
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Letter of Intent (integrated into TBBS): Explain academic background, reason for choosing Turkey, and career expectations.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: PhD/Master's applicants must formulate a structured research proposal: Title, Problem Statement, Literature Review, Methodology, and Significance.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Generated automatically through TBBS profile sections.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Rigorous 20-30 minute in-person interview in Islamabad, Lahore, or Karachi conducted by Turkish academic professors and YTB delegates (evaluates academic knowledge, motivation, and mathematical aptitude).
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: Not required by YTB; SAT/GRE scores provide strong competitive advantage for English-taught engineering programs.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC and MOFA attestation of degree certificates required after award confirmation for university registration.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Turkish or English translations of all non-English documents.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned copy of valid Pakistani passport or NADRA CNIC
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Required for TBBS registration and identity

required_documents_checklist.specification: All degrees and detailed marks sheets
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must show grades and GPA clearly

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Statement of Purpose / Letter of Intent
required_documents_checklist.specification: Formulated directly within the TBBS text fields
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight Pak-Turkish historical and economic ties

required_documents_checklist.specification: Signed letter from professor with institutional contact details
Sports, Olympiad, debate, volunteer, or publication certificates
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Significantly boosts scoring during expert review

important_dates_timeline.interview_period: May - June annually in Islamabad, Lahore, and Karachi
important_dates_timeline.shortlist_announcement: Late July to early August annually
important_dates_timeline.visa_application_window: August - September (Turkish Consulates / Embassy in Pakistan)
important_dates_timeline.semester_commencement: Late September / October of departure year
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single unified application window for all countries and degree levels worldwide.

selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Sincerity and purpose in Letter of Intent)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 15% (In-person interview in Pakistan evaluating composure, motivation, and problem-solving)
selection_process_and_weights.test_scores_weight: Bonus points for GRE / SAT / Turkish language
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Turkish university professors, YTB scholarship experts, and Turkish diplomats.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Three-phase sift: 1) Automated GPA eligibility filter, 2) Expert academic committee review, 3) In-person oral interview in Pakistan.

competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: High academic marks, strong social extracurricular engagement, articulate presentation during in-person interview.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: FSc Pre-Engineering and Pre-Medical students, graduates of UET, NUST, FAST, Quaid-i-Azam, Punjab University, Peshawar University.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Afghanistan, Syria, Azerbaijan, Somalia, Kazakhstan.

fake_websites_and_scams: Scam education consultants in Pakistan charging PKR 50,000 to 200,000 claiming 'direct quota arrangements with the Turkish government'. All applications must be submitted personally on TBBS.
Fake confirmation emails demanding payment for Turkish visa processing.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Türkiye Bursları is 100% FREE. Never pay any application fee.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Applications submitted through intermediaries are frequently disqualified.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Equivalence Certificate (Denklik Belgesi) processing fee from the Turkish Ministry of National Education (MEB) or Turkish Embassy (approx PKR 10,000 to 20,000).
HEC, IBCC, and MOFA degree attestation costs in Pakistan.
Living cost inflation: The monthly stipend (TRY 3,500 to 6,500) covers basic personal spending, but scholars in Istanbul/Ankara often benefit from modest family pocket money support (~$50-100/mo).
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You cannot study in English. (Fact: Hundreds of programs at top Turkish universities are taught in English; however, learning basic Turkish is mandatory for daily life and cultural integration).
MYTH: You must return to Pakistan immediately. (Fact: Turkey allows international graduates to apply for post-study residence permits and work legally in the Turkish economy).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some consultants tell medical applicants that 70% is enough; official YTB regulations strictly enforce a 90% minimum cutoff for Medicine, Dentistry, and Pharmacy.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain minimum GPA specified by Turkish university regulations (typically 2.00/4.00 for Undergrad, 2.50/4.00 for Master's, 3.00/4.00 for PhD).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory full-time attendance. Unexcused absence results in warning and stipend deduction.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Universities submit termly academic transcript reports to YTB.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Undergraduate students can work legally up to 24 hours/week after completing their first year; Master's and PhD students can work part-time with formal work permits.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Scholars sign an agreement promising to return to their home countries upon graduation to foster bilateral relations, though no coercive financial bond is imposed.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholars dismissed for disciplinary violations or voluntary dropout without valid reason may be required to repay travel and allowance costs.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Changing university is strictly prohibited except under exceptional administrative transfers approved by YTB.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Maximum 1 year extension can be granted for thesis completion without monthly stipend (dormitory and tuition remain covered).
